candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and gateway logs show the 500 originating at order (server.address=order) with matching correlation IDs, so the checkout failure is a downstream order error, not a gateway fault.
candidates.uncertainty: Root internal cause at order (DB, code, or dependency) is not established; only the 500 origin is bounded.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s trace to order returning 500 on POST /v1/orders across all sampled correlation IDs, with gateway logs confirming downstream 500s from server_address=order. The bounded finding is an order-side HTTP 500 propagating to checkout; the specific internal fault is not yet established, so order logs and exception detail are required.
